identity.title: William Lane Craig vs Klemens Kappel | "Does God Exist?"
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Named introductions, formal alternating timed speeches, direct address and explicit question/answer handoffs. Official ReasonableFaithOrg upload description identifies Copenhagen, 18 April 2012; organizer catalogue identifies Bethesda.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Full introductions, both openings, both rebuttal rounds, both closings, the complete audience-question period and final thanks/applause are present. The sole >10-second event gap (91:23.480–91:34.800) is the handoff after Craig finishes his closing and before Kappel begins his closing; surrounding sentences are complete. Final captions cover applause to 148:03.309 of the 148:17 video; no final argument is cut off.
content.captionCaution: Names, technical words, isolated negations and mixed-speaker boundary fragments are imperfect. Exact captions remain immutable; uncertain recognition is not an argumentative defect.

participants.questionHandling: Moderator introductions, timekeeping, speaker handoffs and question management are procedural. Audience members ask one-off questions, sometimes with argumentative premises and follow-ups; they are unscored contextual challengers, not recurring co-advocates. Evaluate only the two named debaters’ own replies and explicitly adopted premises. In particular, Quranic-science, ontological-possibility, Caesar and hostile-witness audience premises must not be credited to Craig or Kappel merely for occurring in a question. No primary-speaker substantive passage is excluded.
